text:
Tuna salad with celery, red onion and carrot, on a square plate about 22-26 cm across. The mound is roughly 9×11 cm and about 3 cm high, which works out to around 150 g. Tuna salad made with mayo runs about 1.3-1.9 kcal/g, so I took a middle value of about 1.6 kcal/g, giving roughly 240 kcal.
